issue_request: FHIR-8642 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request from DSTU1 asking that Observation documentation stop referring to appliesDateTime or appliesPeriod after those Observation elements were renamed to effective.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-8642. The underlying rename was applied in 4a0be4946472e6777340612d597280fb5fb968ad for FHIR-7636, and the later QA Observation commit ab0cdd500d54274bf95882abf5e84d0e8892cf6f changed the Observation notes from appliesDateTime/appliesPeriod to effectiveDateTime/effectivePeriod.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the current StructureDefinition source defines Observation.effective[x]. Current source/observation and source/diagnosticreport have no appliesDateTime, appliesPeriod, Observation.applies, or applies[x] hits. The remaining current-source appliesDateTime/appliesPeriod hits are in the Library resource's QUICK model information example, while the FHIR model-definition example represents Observation with the effective choice element; that QUICK example is not the authoritative FHIR Observation documentation for this issue.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current build-scope Observation documentation and StructureDefinition already reflect the requested effective naming.
